summary: The ITProvisionRole module handles CRUD operations and search functionalities related to IT roles within an agency. It includes methods to add, update, delete, and reactivate ITProvisionRole entries and provides search capabilities for placement requests.
purpose: To manage IT roles within an agency, including adding new roles, updating existing ones, and providing search functionality for placement requests.

workflows.name: ITProvisionRole Search
steps: Set procedure name to ITProvRoleSearch or ITProvRoleSearchPlacementRequest.
Add parameters including AgencyID, ShowInactive, PlacementRequestDestinationID, and keyword.
Fill list of ITProvisionRole using retrieved data.

workflows.name: ITProvisionRole CRUD Operations
steps: Validate entry fields for Name and ShortName.
Set procedure name to ITProvRoleAdd, ITProvRoleUpdate, ITProvRoleDelete, or ITProvRoleReactivate.
Add necessary parameters such as SessionID, AgencyID, and entry fields.

conditions.name: IsValid
conditions.details: Validates that Name and ShortName are not blank.

system_behavior: Adds, updates, deletes, and reactivates ITProvisionRole entries based on session parameters.
Searches for ITProvisionRole entries based on agency and placement request details.
